q2: Under source's mutation-and-growth interpretation, what relation can connect distinct resistant cells present at plating? Options: clonal_descendants, conflicting, not_stated, one_origin_per_cell, other, repeated_image, selection_creates_each_origin.

Paper distinguishes mutation events from descendants and interprets fluctuations using clonal relatedness. Neither table assigns colonies to individual mutation origins. Question: what relation can connect distinct resistant cells present at plating? Under mutation interpretation, distinct resistant cells can descend from one earlier resistance mutation; clonal relatedness. Option clonal_descendants: "Several resistant cells can descend from one earlier resistance mutation; cell or colony abundance does not identify the number of origins." This matches. Could there be ambiguity because neither table assigns colonies to origins? But question asks can connect under interpretation, not observed assignment. Evidence establishes. one_origin_per_cell false. selection_creates_each_origin false. repeated_image false. Not conflicting. So q2 = clonal_descendants.
